inputs.checklistItemText: Tree clearances measured from utility pole centerline or structure instead of from outer electric conductor
inputs.question: On Sheet 31 (landscape plan), are there any dimension lines showing tree clearances from overhead electric infrastructure? If yes, do the dimension lines originate from the outer conductor (the actual wire/line), or from the pole centerline?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a two-part presence and identification question: (1) whether dimension lines exist on the sheet, and (2) what feature they originate from. This is a visual inspection for label/annotation presence and source identification, not a measurement of an actual distance between physical features. The measurement compliance itself (tree-to-conductor vs. tree-to-pole-centerline) will be evaluated once these dimensions are located and read.
